outcome.description: done: the work for this hand-off is finished and you already handed the issue back (e.g. PR opened, in_review, assigned to the reviewer). ready_to_ship: the implementation is done and the changed tests pass; Talos starts a fresh session that ships it (only when your role says so). awaiting_bot_review: the PR is open (or a bot round pushed) and the hand-off to the reviewer was deferred (ai ship --defer-handoff); set pr, Talos waits for CodeRabbit (only when your prompt says so). needs_input: a decision or answer is needed. blocked: a tool, permission, environment or dependency stops you. escalate: the issue needs a stronger model to continue.

summary.description: One or two plain-text sentences on what this run did, for the Talos log.

comment.description: HTML for the issue thread. Required for needs_input (the question, options and your recommended option), blocked (what is blocking and what would unblock it) and escalate (why). Empty for done.

handoff.description: Plain text for ready_to_ship: the note the fresh ship session starts from (branch, files changed, decisions, follow-ups, known test failures). Empty otherwise.

pr.description: The PR number, for awaiting_bot_review. Omit otherwise.
